item.title: 🚀 Graduate Guide: What Does a Network Engineer Actually Do?
item.description: A comprehensive career guide for new graduates entering the world of network engineering. Industrial infrastructure, daily operations, and the roadmap to becoming a professional.

item.title: 🛠️ The Backdoor of the Network: Next-Gen Console Server (Terminal Server) Architecture
item.description: A survival guide for when IP access to critical network infrastructure is lost. Out-of-Band Management (OOBM), HTML5 CLI, and automation-supported console servers.

item.title: 🛡️ Visibility and Security Strategy in Enterprise Networks: Network Packet Broker (NPB) Masterclass
item.description: Strategic guide for traffic management, cybersecurity, and end-to-end visibility in enterprise networks. What is NPB? How to manage it with NIAC principles?

item.title: Network Infrastructure Product Selection: Strategic Criteria and Field Experiences
item.description: Why is product selection in enterprise network projects more than a technical checklist? A field-tested framework for evaluating Firewalls, Switches, and APs — beyond datasheets and vendor promises.

item.title: Switch, Firewall, AP — Why Choosing the Right Products Is Not Enough
item.description: Most enterprise network projects fail not because of wrong products, but because of fragmented architecture. A deep-dive into firewall, switching, AP selection, capacity planning, and vendor reality from 11+ years of field experience.
